about_the_game:
About This Game

Step into the neon lit streets of a cyberpunk metropolis and experience the first taste of running your own futuristic store. The Cyberpunk Store Simulator Demo focuses on the heart of the game: managing, expanding, and surviving as a store owner in a high tech dystopia.

In this demo, you’ll stock shelves, scan products, manage resources, and upgrade your store with futuristic décor and systems. You’ll also test unique mechanics like controlling drones and witnessing the city’s hovercars fly past your shop. While the full game will feature deep NPC reputation systems, a vast open world, and advanced customer interactions, the demo focuses on giving you a grounded look at the store management core gameplay.

Demo Key Features

  • Hands-on Store Gameplay: Scan items at the counter, manage your stock, set prices, and keep your shelves filled.

  • Resource & Product Management: Balance supply and demand, track your goods, and make the most of limited resources.

  • Cybernetic Goods: Sell implants and advanced tech to customers (demo focuses on sales only, no implant installations yet).

  • Shop Customization: Upgrade your store with neon signs, décor, and security improvements.

  • Hovercars: Experience the city atmosphere with flying cars outside and drive flying car.

  • Early Progression: Start small and take the first steps toward building your cyber store empire.

The demo gives you a store focused slice of the larger Cyberpunk Store Simulator world. The full version will expand with reputation systems, open world exploration, and deeper NPC interactions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 3.0 GHz or Ryzen 3xxx
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (recent generation)
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070 or better 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Cyberpunk Store Simulator puts you in charge of a neon lit shop in a dystopian city. Manage stock, serve customers, sell cybernetic implants, and explore the streets. Build, customize, and grow your store into a futuristic empire.
